info.title: ServiceGrid IQ implemented Phase 3 intake API
info.description: Local implementation contract. Owner/dispatcher only. Arrival instants require an offset, end after start and at most seven days later. Duration and travel are estimates, not appointments. Draft edits and transitions require the latest version. TRIAGED must return to DRAFT with a reason before editing. History contains the newest 20 other equipment requests; timeline contains the newest 100 events. No deletion, equipment relocation, technician queue access or scheduling is implemented.
